description: Search federal contract AWARDS already made (USASpending, served from FedWatch's relay-ingested copy — a fleet machine syncs USASpending daily because USASpending blocks direct Worker fetches): who won, how much, which agency, period of performance. Filter by keyword, NAICS, and/or agency; sort by amount (default) or most recent. Every response states its data-as-of and the true total_matches under the filters. The incumbency/recompete evidence layer.

agency.description: Agency name fragment to require, e.g. 'Veterans Affairs'

keyword.description: Keyword, e.g. a service or incumbent name

name: contracts_search_awards
